fields.description: Stored integrity word for the save header. FUN_0800181c loads the full 0x2000-byte image (EEPROM blocks 0..0x3FF) into the heap save buffer and rejects it unless the u32 at buffer+0 equals the low 16 bits of its table-driven CRC-16 over buffer+4; FUN_08002544 recomputes the same CRC and stamps it here before writing EEPROM block 0. Upper 16 bits are always zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800181c verifies *puVar9 (save offset 0) against (CRC16 & 0xffff) and sets buffer word 2 on mismatch; FUN_08002544 recomputes the CRC over the buffer and stores it at save offset 0 before calling FUN_080027a4 block 0.
fields.name: save_checksum

fields.description: Fixed save-format identifier stamped by the game. FUN_0800181c rejects the loaded image unless the u32 at buffer+4 equals the ROM constant; FUN_08002544 re-stamps the same constant before writing EEPROM block 0. Reads 0xbd2a5921 in the logical (rev8) domain.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800181c compares puVar9[1] (save offset 4) against the ROM magic constant; FUN_08002544 writes the constant back to save offset 4 before FUN_080027a4 block 0.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Load-validity flag. Set to 1 by FUN_0800181c when the checksum or magic check fails (buffer word 2 = 1); cleared to 0 by FUN_08002544 whenever the header is re-stamped. EEPROM block 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800181c sets puVar9[2] (save offset 8) to 1 on verification failure; FUN_08002544 clears save offset 8 to 0 before FUN_080027a4 block 0.
fields.name: load_error_flag

fields.description: Second header status word. Never set in the visible decompilation; zeroed by FUN_08002544 on every header re-stamp and covered by the FUN_0800181c header CRC. Reserved/auxiliary status.
fields.evidence: FUN_08002544 clears save offset 12 (puVar15[3] = 0) before recomputing the header CRC and calling FUN_080027a4 block 0; FUN_0800181c covers save offset 12 in its CRC span.
fields.name: aux_status_word

fields.description: Select-slot entry 0: 1-based game/select ID (0 = empty). The 8-byte slot at save 0xA0 is copied to RAM at boot by FUN_08001b94 and each of the first four bytes becomes a per-slot object holding (byte - 1) via FUN_080901ac.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b94 copies 8 bytes from save buffer+0xA0; FUN_0800ba8c builds one object per byte and stores (byte - 1) with FUN_080901ac for bytes at save offsets 0xA0..0xA3.
fields.name: select_slot_0

fields.description: Select-slot entry 1: 1-based game/select ID (0 = empty). Consumed at boot the same way as select_slot_0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b94 copies 8 bytes from save buffer+0xA0; FUN_0800ba8c builds one object per byte and stores (byte - 1) with FUN_080901ac for bytes at save offsets 0xA0..0xA3.
fields.name: select_slot_1

fields.description: Select-slot entry 2: 1-based game/select ID (0 = empty). Consumed at boot the same way as select_slot_0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b94 copies 8 bytes from save buffer+0xA0; FUN_0800ba8c builds one object per byte and stores (byte - 1) with FUN_080901ac for bytes at save offsets 0xA0..0xA3.
fields.name: select_slot_2

fields.description: Select-slot entry 3: 1-based game/select ID (0 = empty). Consumed at boot the same way as select_slot_0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001b94 copies 8 bytes from save buffer+0xA0; FUN_0800ba8c builds one object per byte and stores (byte - 1) with FUN_080901ac for bytes at save offsets 0xA0..0xA3.
fields.name: select_slot_3

fields.description: Slot write-pending word. When nonzero, FUN_08002544 zeroes save bytes 0xA4..0xA7 and rewrites EEPROM block 0x14 (save 0xA0..0xA7); FUN_08002890 also zeroes the whole 8-byte slot when it differs from zeros. Baseline reads 0 (clean).
fields.evidence: FUN_08002544 tests puVar15[0x29] (save offset 0xA4): if nonzero it zeroes save 0xA4..0xA7 and calls FUN_080027a4 block 0x14; FUN_08002890 compares save 0xA0..0xA7 against zeros and clears it on mismatch.
fields.name: slot_write_pending

magic_signatures.description: Save-format magic stamped by FUN_08002544 and verified by FUN_0800181c (u32 0xbd2a5921, logical rev8 domain)
